For a car accident injury case in Pleasanton, California, you can consult several local and East Bay-based personal injury law firms that handle auto collisions on a contingency-fee basis (no upfront costs):

Website: Personal Injury | Pleasanton Accident Lawyer Stephen M. Fuerch
Fee Structure: Almost all California car accident attorneys operate on a contingency fee (typically 33.3% to 40% of the recovery), meaning you pay zero upfront or out-of-pocket costs unless they recover money for you. Kleczek Law Office +2
Statute of Limitations: Under California Code of Civil Procedure § 335.1, you generally have two years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit (or 6 months if a government entity is involved). Venardi Zurada LLP +1
Comparative Negligence: California follows a pure comparative negligence rule, meaning your final compensation can be reduced by your percentage of fault in the crash. Karns and Karns +1
